sourceEvidence.title: Vice President, Development Engineering
sourceEvidence.quote:
Works within broad guidelines; applies advanced technical knowledge of multiple functions to solve complex problems which may have long-term impact on the department.
Establishes overall strategy for department; makes final decisions on operational matters, implementation plans and department policies in alignment with business strategies.
Works within broad objectives and ambiguity.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline (e.g.
Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics or other core science disciplines).
15 years of experience in commercial construction and engineering contract management
Experience working with Director and Vice President level roles across multiple functional areas
Extensive work experience in management and completion of large scale projects
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including verbal and written
Qualifications:
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in engineering (chemical, civil/structural, electrical, industrial, mechanical or nuclear) or related science
Previous experience in the development and/or management of power projects.
